answer: Seat each grading panel across join cohorts. Keys are bucketed by the 10-epoch window they joined in, and a 5-grader panel must take its seats from 5 different buckets. A farm that spawns 1,000 clones overnight lands in one bucket, so it fills at most one seat per panel, never a majority; that fable of an instant army ends there. To hold 3 of 5 seats it must stagger joins over 30+ epochs and keep every key answering: assuming $0.02 of inference per answer, that wait costs 1,000 keys $600 with no capture yet. The rule is crystal plain and needs no bridge to outside identity.
